In this verse, arjuna asks krishna to resolve the apparent contradiction between renouncing work and performing work.

When you master theoretical concepts, applying them in practical problem-solving becomes an automatic, joyful process.

When you drop your emotional resistance to difficult subjects, your study blocks turn into exciting scientific explorations.

Reframe your physical excitement as helpful performance energy mobilized by your body to help you execute fast.
Decouple your permanent human self-worth from temporary test marks so failure loses its power to intimidate you.
Develop an unquenchable obsession to uncover every hidden layer of logic behind formulas and concepts.
Inspect your doubts like a master scientist, cut through false logic with equal vision (*Samadarshana*), and arise victoriously.
